source_text: Ethnographic analyses reveal no evidence of female agency in initiations, which occur pre-puberty without informed consent, contrasting voluntary practices; instead, FGM causally entrenches dependency by linking women's social value to mutilated bodies, incompatible with individual autonomy principles.
